Fact_table.value:
concat('"Select DW_Holder_Key,DW_AGG_Key,DW_Gate_Key,DW_Run_Key, IO_date,Count( case when IOStatus='Exit' then 1 else null end)  IOStatus_ExCnt, Count( case when IOStatus='Entry' then 1 else null end,'' And  '',string(variables('G_Run_End_DT')),'"'
                        )
                       
      ) AS A 
      LEFT OUTER JOIN 
      (
              SELECT EmployeeName,IODate as PrevDate, IODate,convert(varchar, IOTime,108)  as IOTime,IOStatus ,
              (select DW_Holder_Key from dim_holder where Holder_Name=EmployeeName ) as Holder_Key
              FROM OOOIOEntry
              WHERE Reason = 'Final Exit'  
              and cast(substring(convert(varchar, IOTime,108),1,2) as int) < 12
      ) AS E
      
      ON A.DW_Holder_Key = E.Holder_Key
      AND A.IODate = (e.PrevDate)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN
      (
              SELECT EmployeeName, IODate+1 as NextDate, IODate,convert(varchar, IOTime,108) as IOTime,IOStatus,
               (select DW_Holder_Key from dim_holder where Holder_Name=EmployeeName ) as Holder_Key
              FROM OOOIOEntry   
              WHERE Reason = 'Final Exit'    
              and cast(substring(convert(varchar, IOTime,108),1,2) as int) < 12
      ) AS S
      ON A.DW_Holder_Key = s.Holder_Key
      AND A.IODate = (S.NextDate)
) as AA
Group By DW_Holder_Key,Dw_Gate_Key,Dw_agg_Key,Dw_Run_Key, IO_date"')

From( 
      Select a.*,ISNULL(ISNULL(E.IODate,S.IODate),a.IODate) IO_Date
      FROM
      (
                        SELECT * 
                        FROM  FACT I    
                        where 
                        (
                        iodate Between '11/11/2010 11:22:30 AM' And  '11/11/2010 11:22:22 AM'
                        )

      (
              SELECT EmployeeName, IODate+1 as NextDate, IODate,convert(varchar, IOTime,108) as IOTime,IOStatus,
               (select DW_Holder_Key from dim_holder where Holder_Name=EmployeeName ) as Holder_Key
              FROM OOOIOEntry   
              WHERE Reason = 'Final Exit'    
              and cast(substring(convert(varchar, IOTime,108),1,2) as int) < 12
